timeline.body: I was wondering whether `Maps.deepEquals(...)` be used here? But I don't think that is the case since we never have arrays as value in this map. So this should be good.
Maybe create a variant of this test that creates a random deep map? I don't think `PipelineConfiguration` cares about that content being valid.
